'''Operation Eternal Domain''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and the Imperial Navy [[Battle of Nez Peron|destroyed]] a Republic fighter wing over the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Nez Peron/Legends|Nez Peron]], and [[Battle of Sarapin Four|destroyed]] the Republic warship ''[[Enkindle]]'' at [[Sarapin Four]].
